subject: @abh/core bounded binary media staging through the existing ObjectStore protocol
coverage: storeObjectArtifact dispatches string content to the unchanged text/JSON staging path and Uint8Array content to binary staging
binary content is copied into private storage before digest and external put
size is strictly greater than 65536 and at most 262144 bytes
MIME is restricted to PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF
magic bytes are sniffed and declared-versus-sniffed mismatches are rejected
a valid 70000-byte PNG completes put, readback, publish and authorized read
Artifact storage remains metadata-only with a null inline body
the staging attempt reaches Published after T2 publication
limits: production cloud or remote ObjectStore adapters remain host-installed
Pending staging attempts that never received a tracking ref are not physically addressable
a process crash between an adapter returning Completed and Core recording its response remains unavoidable without a portable two-phase port
binary media staging does not change the Tool JSON output path
